rss: From Levi's to Primark - the fashion chains selling mended clothes
title: Old Clothes Get New Life!
story: Kids are loving clothes with fun patches and bright stitches. Now, some stores are making it cool to wear clothes that are fixed rather than new!
storyBig: A growing trend is making patched and visibly mended clothes fashionable, encouraging sustainable practices in the fashion industry. This reflects a shift in consumer preferences, where visible repairs are celebrated rather than hidden.
think: Why might people choose mended clothes over new ones?
bull: It's great to see people recycling and saving materials.
bear: Some might still prefer new things because they look perfect.

rss: How video game remakes tap the power of nostalgia
title: Old Games Make a Comeback!
story: Playing old video games can be exciting because they remind people of fun times. Many game makers are bringing back these old games with new looks!
storyBig: The resurgence of classic video games showcases the impactful business strategy of leveraging nostalgia. Companies are successfully capturing both old fans and new players by remaking beloved games with modern enhancements.
think: Why do people enjoy playing games they played a long time ago?
bull: Remaking old games can bring joy to new players and old fans.
bear: If games are too old, they might not feel fun to everyone.
